Maya: Quick sync — affected tenants reporting slower embeddings/indexing since 02:14 UTC. Need a short customer-facing status + plan (initial status, RCA promise, office hours, feedback). Who can confirm the RCA bullets?
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-21-indexer-lag — detected 02:14 UTC; degraded embeddings throughput; mitigation applied 03:05 UTC (autoscale bump + KV cache flush).
Amit: Root cause summary in one line: race in shard rebalance triggered repeated local GC + IO stalls. We'll turn that into 3 plain-language bullets.
Lena: Draft outbound below — keeping it tight. PTAL.
Lena: ```
Subject: Status update: temporary indexing degradation — immediate steps we took

Hi —
We’re reaching out to let you know about an indexing/embeddings degradation that affected a subset of tenants from 02:14–03:05 UTC on 2026-03-21.
Impact: slower or delayed embeddings indexing for affected tenants; reads were not impacted and no customer data was changed.
Mitigation: increased capacity and cache refreshes restored normal throughput.
Next steps: we’re publishing a full RCA within 24 hours and hosting office hours for impacted teams (register link included).
If you rely on real-time indexes for customer-facing flows and need urgent help, reply and we’ll prioritize.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Customer Success
```
Priya: I can run the office hours tomorrow 16:00 UTC — I’ll create the registration and a 10–15 min Q&A slot. Need a simple slide deck from eng (timeline + mitigation + next steps).
Amit: Slide deck: I’ll put together 4 slides (timeline, root cause, mitigation steps, next steps). Uploading: https://redwood.internal/docs/incident/6001234567-deck (draft).
Tom: For credits — recommend a single line in the note: "We will evaluate account-level credits for impacted usage; your CSM will follow up." Finance OKs a streamlined credit equal to one day average usage for tenants meeting impact threshold.
Maya: Proposed send flow: Lena finalizes draft -> Tom signs off on credit language -> Maya publishes initial status within 2 hours -> full RCA doc + deck within 24 hours -> Priya sends office hours invite in the initial note. Sound good?
Lena: Sounds good. I’ll remove technical jargon and emphasize "no customer data was changed." Drafting now.
Priya: Also adding a 2-question feedback form post-office-hours: 1) Was this incident blocking your workflows? (yes/no) 2) Any feature-level feedback. Keeps it light.
Amit: For the RCA technical bullets (plain language): 1) race in shard rebalancer caused repeated local memory pressure; 2) local GC and disk IO contention slowed writes; 3) a reorder fix and guardrails were deployed to stop rebalance overlaps. Patch will roll to other regions by EOD.
incident-bot: Status changed to 'stabilized' at 6001234390.
Maya: Checklist before send: 1) Lena finalizes outbound (30m), 2) Tom approves credit phrasing (1h), 3) Maya sends initial status, 4) Priya schedules office hours (done), 5) Amit publishes RCA doc (4h).
Tom: Approved the credit framework; finance flagged to apply credits fast. :white_check_mark:
Lena: Outbound ready. Pasting final short note here so we can review:
Lena: "Hi — we experienced an indexing performance degradation affecting a subset of tenants between 02:14–03:05 UTC on 2026-03-21. We restored normal throughput by increasing capacity and refreshing internal caches. No customer data was modified. We’ll publish a detailed RCA within 24 hours and invite you to office hours for questions. Your CSM will follow up about any account credits if you were materially impacted"
Maya: OK going to send the status to the affected list now. I’ll include the office hours registration and a link to the deck when it’s ready.
Maya: Sent initial status to affected tenants (job id 987654).
Priya: Registration created: https://redwood.events/office-hours/6001234567 — I added the feedback form.
Amit: RCA doc will be live at the same doc link by EOD. I’ll post a short changelog once the region rollouts complete.
CS-bot: Added thread note to customer incident tracker: incident-6001234567, owners: Maya, Amit, Priya.
Maya: Thanks team — follow-ups: Lena to paste final email thread into support ticket, Tom to confirm finance applies credits, Priya to host office hours, Amit to update RCA doc and run the region rollout. We’ll reconvene in 2h if anything changes. :raising_hand:
